description: Build the draft sequence an account health insight asks for, from an unhandled_event or missing_sequence insight (its primary action kind is create_sequence). Creates an inactive sequence with its timing and empty, titled email steps: for unhandled_event, triggered by the event and named for the moment (for example New customer onboarding for saas.purchase); for missing_sequence, with the name, trigger (contact added, an event, or manual enrollment) and steps from the insight's evidence. Like a sequence from a template, a new draft has its emails written with AI: enrichmentStatus is processing while they are written (get_sequence reports progress), or not_queued when writing could not start (opening the sequence in the dashboard starts it; do not build again). Running it again returns the same draft with created false; steps that still have no email (for example a check's own draft nobody opened yet) are written then, with enrichmentStatus, and existing emails are never rewritten. 409 IN_PROGRESS when another build of the same insight is running; 400 for other insight types. Show it with get_sequence; enable_sequence only works once every email step has an email, and only after the user approves. Requires sequences:write.
